verdict_reason: The new commonName read reaches no payload field and no test, and two names (legacyAnimalCount, u) do not say what they hold.

todos.issue: The diff adds commonName to every joined line (line 40) and to commodityObligations (line 62), but the only consumer of these lines, mapper-a (commodity.js, species-entry.js), never reads line.commonName, and no test fixture in notification-mapper.test.js sets one. The read is unreachable from any output and untested. See the commodity.js finding on where the common name should go.
todos.fix: Must: every field the line join reads reaches the mapped payload and a test proves it, or the join does not read it. One way: once the commodity-name decision is made, either map line.commonName in speciesEntryFromLine with a mapper test asserting it, or remove commonName from lineFrom and commodityObligations.

todos.issue: legacyAnimalCount (line 13) does not predict its value: it returns the count as text for the backend's string field, and 'legacy' is a history word. The callback parameter u (line 47) holds a unit fulfilment index and its name says nothing.
todos.fix: Must: each name says what it holds or returns, with no history word. One way: rename legacyAnimalCount to animalCountText and u to unitIndex.
